fields.description: A short label you choose, e.g. Alpha, Beta, Gamma, PBS.
fields.label: Server Name

fields.description: FQDN or IP used to reach the API, e.g. alpha.example.com
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Proxmox API token in the form user@realm!token-id, e.g. monitor@pve!dashboard. Read-only monitoring credential — deliberately does not have VM.Console; see Console Username/Password below for that.
fields.label: API Token ID

fields.description: The secret/UUID portion of the API token. Stored encrypted; never exposed to the Viewer role.
fields.label: API Token Secret

fields.description: Leave unchecked for self-signed certificates (the norm for a private Proxmox host).
fields.label: Verify SSL Certificate

fields.description: Informational only — the actual retention is whatever your vzdump job is configured with on this host, e.g. "14 daily" for Alpha vs "3 daily" for Beta/Gamma.
fields.label: Local Backup Retention (informational)
Console Access (separate PVE login — API tokens can't authenticate the console websocket)

fields.description: A Proxmox username (e.g. monitor@pve or root@pam), with VM.Console permission, used only to open embedded VNC/terminal sessions to this server's guests. Deliberately a real username+password login, not an API token: Proxmox's vncwebsocket endpoint rejects API-token auth outright (confirmed against real Proxmox hosts and documented in the Proxmox community) — it only accepts a PVEAuthCookie session obtained via username+password, the same way Proxmox's own web UI logs in. Leave both Console fields blank to disable console access for this server's guests.
fields.label: Console Username

fields.description: Password for the console login user above. Stored encrypted; never exposed to the Viewer role. Used only to obtain a short-lived PVEAuthCookie ticket per console session — never stored longer than that.
fields.label: Console Password
Live Status (updated automatically by the poller)

fields.description: Set when the most recently processed backup task (local vzdump or PBS-targeted) on this host failed. OR'd into Is Critical alongside CPU/RAM.
fields.label: Backup Critical

fields.description: Consecutive polls CPU/RAM has stayed at-or-above the Warning Threshold. Cleared to 0 the moment a reading dips back below it; a Warning alert only fires once this reaches the configured Confirmation Checks.
fields.label: Warning Streak

fields.description: Consecutive polls CPU/RAM has stayed at-or-above the Critical Threshold. Cleared to 0 the moment a reading dips back below it; a Critical alert only fires once this reaches the configured Confirmation Checks.
fields.label: Critical Streak

fields.description: Informational only, like Root Disk Usage below — not part of Is Critical/Is Warning. Null (shown as N/A) when the host has no swap configured.
fields.label: Swap Usage

fields.description: Root filesystem (Drive 1: OS + local backups) usage.
fields.label: Root Disk Usage
